domains.title: OWASP Top 10 in Code
domains.intro: Injection, cross-site scripting, SSRF, insecure deserialization, path traversal and unsafe file upload, traced from untrusted input to dangerous sink.

items.issue: SQL queries are parameterized; no string-built SQL
items.review: Trace every request parameter to each DB call, including ORM raw()/native queries and stored procedures.

items.issue: NoSQL queries reject operator injection and untyped input
items.review: Check Mongo/Dynamo/Elastic filters built from req.body; look for $where, $ne, $regex.

items.issue: No OS command or dynamic code execution with user-influenced data
items.review: Inspect shell-outs, template engines, report generators, file converters.

items.issue: Output is context-encoded; no raw HTML sinks (XSS)
items.review: Check templates, client-side rendering, rich-text/markdown renderers, CSP presence.

items.issue: Server-side requests to user-supplied URLs are allowlisted (SSRF)
items.review: Look at webhooks, URL importers, image fetchers, PDF renderers, metadata endpoint exposure.

items.issue: Untrusted data is never natively deserialized; XML parsers disable external entities
items.review: Check session stores, message queues, caches, SAML/XML parsing.

items.issue: File paths are canonicalized and confined to an allowed base directory
items.review: Check download/export/attachment/template-include handlers.

items.issue: File uploads validate type, size and name, and are stored non-executable
items.review: Verify content sniffing, extension allowlist, storage location, AV scanning, served Content-Type/disposition.

items.issue: Redirects and forwards use allowlisted targets
items.review: Check login 'next', SSO return URLs, logout redirects.

items.issue: CSRF protection is active on state-changing cookie-authenticated routes
items.review: Confirm tokens or SameSite+custom-header strategy on all POST/PUT/DELETE.

domains.title: Access Control
domains.intro: Authorization on every object and function; IDOR; privilege escalation through role or parameter tampering.

items.issue: Every protected function enforces server-side authorization (deny by default)
items.review: Enumerate routes/controllers/GraphQL resolvers/jobs and confirm each has an explicit policy check.

items.issue: Object access is scoped to the owner or authorized role (no IDOR)
items.review: For each lookup by ID, confirm tenant/owner filter or policy; test taxpayer/case/record IDs.

items.issue: Roles and privilege flags cannot be set or elevated by the client
items.review: Check profile-update, registration and admin-create endpoints for bindable role/status fields.

items.issue: Identity and role are never trusted from client-controllable headers or cookies
items.review: Check gateway/proxy trust model and header stripping.

items.issue: UI-level hiding is backed by server enforcement
items.review: Compare front-end role checks with the API they call.

items.issue: Staff/admin functions are separated and least-privilege (RBAC/ABAC)
items.review: Review role model, privilege separation, break-glass paths and who can read FTI.

domains.title: SSO and Identity
domains.intro: SAML, OIDC and JWT validation; redirect allowlisting; IdP claim to role mapping; no local login or debug routes that bypass SSO.

items.issue: SAML responses/assertions are signature-validated against IdP metadata
items.review: Confirm library config (strict mode, wantAssertionsSigned, cert pinning, XSW protection).

items.issue: SAML audience and recipient restrictions are enforced
items.review: Check Audience == SP entityID and Recipient == ACS URL.

items.issue: SAML replay protection (InResponseTo, NotOnOrAfter, assertion ID cache)
items.review: Check clock skew limits and one-time assertion cache.

items.issue: OIDC uses state, nonce and PKCE
items.review: Trace the authorization request and callback handler.

items.issue: Redirect URIs are exact-match allowlisted
items.review: Check client registration config and runtime redirect handling.

items.issue: JWTs are verified for signature, issuer, audience, expiry; 'none' rejected; algorithm pinned
items.review: Check every verify call, key source (JWKS), and algorithm list.

items.issue: Application roles are mapped from IdP claims through a server-side allowlist
items.review: Check claim-to-role mapping, default role, unknown-group handling.

items.issue: No leftover local logins, debug routes or auth-bypass switches
items.review: Search for local-auth strategies, seed admin accounts, feature flags, test endpoints.

domains.title: Session Management
domains.intro: Timeouts, single logout, session fixation and cookie flags.

items.issue: Session cookies set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite
items.review: Check framework session config and any manual Set-Cookie.

items.issue: Idle and absolute session timeouts are enforced
items.review: Confirm values against agency policy and server-side enforcement.

items.issue: Session ID is regenerated on login and privilege change (fixation)
items.review: Inspect the login handler.

items.issue: Single logout / server-side invalidation and token revocation
items.review: Check logout handler, SLO endpoints, refresh-token revocation.

items.issue: Tokens are not stored in script-readable browser storage
items.review: Check SPA token storage.

items.issue: Session identifiers are not accepted from URLs
items.review: Check URL rewriting and parameter handling.

domains.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
domains.intro: MFA enforcement, especially on staff and administrator paths.

items.issue: MFA is enforced for administrator and staff authentication
items.review: Check IdP policy references, amr/acr claim checks, step-up for sensitive actions.

items.issue: MFA cannot be disabled or bypassed by configuration or parameter
items.review: Search flags, env vars, remembered-device logic and recovery flows.

items.issue: MFA enrolment and recovery flows are protected against takeover
items.review: Review reset, backup codes, factor changes, rate limits.

domains.title: Secrets Management
domains.intro: Hardcoded keys, tokens and passwords in the working tree and in git history.

items.issue: No hardcoded credentials, keys or tokens in source or config
items.review: Review every scanner hit; check config templates and CI files.

items.issue: No private keys, keystores or env files committed
items.review: Check repository file inventory.

items.issue: Git history contains no secrets (or they are rotated)
items.review: Review git-history scan; confirm rotation for any live credential.

items.issue: Secrets are loaded from a secrets manager / environment at runtime, not baked into images
items.review: Check Dockerfiles, compose, K8s manifests, Terraform variables.

domains.title: Dependencies and SBOM
domains.intro: Known CVEs, outdated or abandoned packages, reproducible builds and a software bill of materials.

items.issue: No dependencies with known critical/high vulnerabilities
items.review: Run a connected OSV/NVD scan and import results with --osv-results.

items.issue: No abandoned or end-of-life packages
items.review: Review top-level dependencies for maintenance status.

items.issue: Dependencies are pinned and lockfiles committed
items.review: Check manifests and CI install commands (npm ci, pip --require-hashes).

items.issue: Dependency sources are trusted: no typosquatted names, remote-fetching install or startup scripts (curl | sh, source <(curl ...)), plain-HTTP registries or dependency-confusion indexes
items.review: SBOM produced by this audit; confirm it is produced in CI per release.

domains.title: Cryptography
domains.intro: Weak algorithms, static IVs, homegrown crypto and TLS configuration.

items.issue: Approved hashes only; passwords use Argon2id/bcrypt/scrypt/PBKDF2
items.review: Check password storage and integrity checks.

items.issue: Strong ciphers and modes (AES-GCM); no DES/RC4/ECB
items.review: Check all encryption call sites and library defaults.

items.issue: IVs/nonces/salts are random and unique per operation
items.review: Inspect encryption helpers.

items.issue: Security-relevant randomness uses a CSPRNG
items.review: Check token, reset-code and OTP generation.

items.issue: TLS certificate and hostname validation are never disabled
items.review: Check HTTP, DB and queue clients.

items.issue: TLS 1.2+ only with strong ciphers; FIPS-validated modules for FTI
items.review: Check nginx/Apache/ALB/Spring/IIS config and runtime crypto provider.

items.issue: No homegrown cryptography or encoding used as protection
items.review: Search for custom encrypt/hash helpers.

domains.title: Data Protection (PII / FTI)
domains.intro: Encryption at rest, masking, leakage into logs and error messages, and retention handling for SSNs, financial records and federal tax information.

items.issue: SSN/TIN/financial fields are encrypted at rest (field-level or equivalent)
items.review: Inspect models/DDL, ORM column types, KMS usage, key custody.

items.issue: Sensitive values are masked in UI, API responses and exports
items.review: Check serializers/DTOs and report generators.

items.issue: No PII/FTI or secrets written to logs
items.review: Check logging calls and framework request/response logging.

items.issue: No real PII/FTI in source, fixtures, dumps or backups
items.review: Review fixtures and data files.

items.issue: Retention, purge and disposal handling is implemented
items.review: Check scheduled jobs, soft-delete, backup lifecycle.

items.issue: Sensitive responses are not cacheable
items.review: Check Cache-Control on authenticated pages.

domains.title: API Security
domains.intro: Authentication on every endpoint, input validation, rate limiting and mass assignment.

items.issue: Every endpoint requires authentication unless explicitly public
items.review: Enumerate routes; verify global auth middleware and public allowlist.

items.issue: Inputs are validated with allowlist schemas
items.review: Check DTO/schema validation on every route.

items.issue: Rate limiting protects login, reset, MFA, search and export
items.review: Check app, gateway and WAF controls.

items.issue: Mass assignment is prevented (explicit bindable fields)
items.review: Check create/update handlers.

items.issue: GraphQL introspection and API docs are disabled or protected in production
items.review: Check production configuration.

domains.title: Infrastructure as Code and Configuration
domains.intro: Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, Dockerfiles, storage exposure, IAM scope, encryption, CORS and security headers.

items.issue: No publicly accessible storage buckets or containers
items.review: Check bucket ACLs, policies and public-access-block settings.

items.issue: IAM policies follow least privilege (no wildcard action/resource/principal)
items.review: Review roles attached to workloads and CI.

items.issue: No unrestricted ingress (0.0.0.0/0) to admin or data ports
items.review: Review security groups, NSGs, firewall rules and compose port bindings.

items.issue: Encryption at rest enabled with managed keys and rotation
items.review: Check EBS/RDS/S3/Dynamo/Elastic/Blob settings.

items.issue: Encryption in transit enforced; HTTP redirected to HTTPS
items.review: Check load balancer, CDN and DB TLS settings.

items.issue: Containers run non-root, unprivileged, pinned images
items.review: Review Dockerfiles and manifests; PodSecurity level.

items.issue: Debug/dev features are disabled for production
items.review: Check environment-specific config.

items.issue: CORS is restricted to trusted origins
items.review: Check all CORS configuration layers.

items.issue: Security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff) are set
items.review: Check app middleware, web server and CDN.

items.issue: Cloud audit logging is enabled with adequate retention
items.review: Check CloudTrail/Activity Log/flow logs/bucket logging.

items.issue: CI/CD pipelines are hardened: no script injection, pinned third-party actions, least-privilege tokens, no secrets in logs
items.review: Read every workflow under .github/workflows: triggers (pull_request_target, workflow_run), run steps that expand event data, uses: pins, permissions blocks and any step that handles secrets.

domains.title: Logging and Audit Trails
domains.intro: Security events captured and tamper-evident; no sensitive data in logs.

items.issue: Authentication, authorization failures and admin actions are logged
items.review: Check login, MFA, role change, export and delete paths.

items.issue: Access to PII/FTI is recorded in an audit trail (who/what/when/where/outcome)
items.review: Confirm read-access auditing, not just writes.

items.issue: Logs contain no sensitive data and resist injection
items.review: Check redaction filters and log formats.

items.issue: Errors are not silently swallowed
items.review: Review empty catch/except blocks around security logic.

items.issue: Logs are centralized, protected from tampering and retained per policy
items.review: Check shipping, permissions and retention config.

domains.title: Error Handling
domains.intro: No stack traces or internal details exposed to users.

items.issue: Stack traces and exception details are not returned to clients
items.review: Check exception handlers and response bodies.

items.issue: A global handler returns generic errors with a correlation ID
items.review: Check framework error pages and fallbacks.

items.issue: Debug pages and verbose errors are disabled in production
items.review: Check production configuration.

items.issue: Failures in security checks fail closed
items.review: Inspect auth/authorization exception paths.
